searches.phase_reflection: Remote/local continuity should be modeled as handoff-safe state, not raw session cloning.
searches.runner_implication: Startup receipts should record branch, phase, and safe resume context without private routes.

searches.phase_reflection: Compact is a first-class continuity event and needs a pre/post snapshot habit.
searches.runner_implication: Compact updater runner should create a timestamped context card before or after compaction.

searches.query: OpenAI Codex changelog local remote thread handoff
searches.phase_reflection: Thread handoff has become an official surface, so repo receipts should be ready to survive host shifts.
searches.runner_implication: Runners should write host-neutral relative lookup files and remote-equals-local checks.

searches.phase_reflection: Persistent guidance belongs in explicit instruction files or receipts, not hidden assumptions.
searches.runner_implication: Startup updater should surface the current rule set from omega-mini before work begins.

searches.phase_reflection: Background execution is strongest when isolated from unfinished work.
searches.runner_implication: Safe orchestration should keep runner outputs in phase receipts and avoid global state mutation.

searches.phase_reflection: Independent worktrees support parallel tasks without collisions.
searches.runner_implication: The x2 runner layer should record which branch/worktree owns a receipt.

searches.phase_reflection: App-server surfaces require careful auth and localhost boundaries.
searches.runner_implication: No runner should publish raw app-server endpoints, tokens, or private callable material.

searches.phase_reflection: Skills are the right durable home for repeated runner workflows.
searches.runner_implication: New v6 x2 skills should stay concise and trigger-specific.

searches.query: Codex app features worktrees automations Git functionality
searches.phase_reflection: The app is designed for parallel threads and reviewable Git work.
searches.runner_implication: Phase receipts should keep diffs reviewable and avoid mixing active and held sibling lanes.

searches.phase_reflection: Machine-readable event streams are useful for deterministic runner ledgers.
searches.runner_implication: Future runners can consume JSON/JSONL status, while this phase stores compact JSON receipts.

searches.phase_reflection: PreCompact and PostCompact are natural trigger points for continuity snapshots.
searches.runner_implication: Do not install global hooks in this safe packet; record a manual/hook-ready runner instead.

searches.query: Codex best practices validation and compact
searches.phase_reflection: Good long runs combine planning, validation, and compact/resume hygiene.
searches.runner_implication: The v6 x2 closeout should validate JSON, current-state, privacy, and remote heads.

searches.query: Codex CLI features MCP slash commands
searches.phase_reflection: Tooling should be exposed through explicit, reusable commands and skills.
searches.runner_implication: Runner names and receipts should be stable enough for future slash-command wrappers.

searches.phase_reflection: Parallel agents are useful, but this workflow currently forbids new sibling creation.
searches.runner_implication: Runners should improve already-inducted lane coordination without spawning new agents.

searches.phase_reflection: Background parallel work is an official pattern when isolated and auditable.
searches.runner_implication: The orchestrator should report started, pending, and complete states separately.

searches.query: Codex app server long-lived process JSON-RPC
searches.source: OpenAI blog unlocking the Codex harness
searches.phase_reflection: Long-lived app-server processes make receipt discipline more important.
searches.runner_implication: Status summaries should never include raw streams or private app payloads.

searches.phase_reflection: Async child processes avoid blocking the main event loop when background work is intended.
searches.runner_implication: Use explicit child-process status rows and keep stderr/stdout summarized.

searches.phase_reflection: Receipt creation can be deterministic with simple filesystem primitives.
searches.runner_implication: Runners should create trace directories and write JSON/MD pairs atomically enough for recovery.

searches.phase_reflection: Argument parsing and environment handling need explicit boundaries.
searches.runner_implication: Do not rely on ambiguous boolean flags or publish environment values.

searches.query: Node.js timers unref long running tasks
searches.phase_reflection: Timers can keep a process alive unexpectedly.
searches.runner_implication: Watcher runners should distinguish active background process from completion proof.

searches.phase_reflection: Python remains useful for Windows process launch and return-code receipts.
searches.runner_implication: Use summarized return codes and avoid dumping raw process streams.

searches.phase_reflection: Runner CLIs should be explicit and self-validating.
searches.runner_implication: Future Python runners should use argparse rather than ad hoc argv parsing.

searches.phase_reflection: Timestamps need UTC and human-local context.
searches.runner_implication: Startup and compact receipts should record both UTC and NZ timestamps.

searches.phase_reflection: Parallelism can increase throughput but should remain bounded and auditable.
searches.runner_implication: This phase avoids heavy parallel execution and focuses on safe orchestration receipts.

searches.phase_reflection: Separate working trees reduce branch collision risk.
searches.runner_implication: The current omega-mini-2 worktree should stay the publication surface for this phase.

searches.phase_reflection: Scripted status checks need stable parseable output.
searches.runner_implication: Validation should prefer stable status summaries over broad noisy scans.

searches.phase_reflection: Diff checks catch formatting hazards before publication.
searches.runner_implication: Run diff checks before commit and treat line-ending warnings separately from failures.

searches.phase_reflection: Remote branch verification is cheap and exact.
searches.runner_implication: Closeout should verify local head equals remote head after push.

searches.phase_reflection: Commit comparison is a useful remote audit surface.
searches.runner_implication: GitHub compare can remain optional when git remote equality is already verified.
